en: A black-and-white photographic postcard featuring a panoramic and slightly elevated winter view of a small village. The landscape is covered in snow, with wooden houses arranged in a rural pattern, some with traditional Scandinavian architectural elements. There are fences, a few people visible on the snowy paths, and wooded hills in the background. The words 'Lillhärdal.' and 'Foto: J. E. Nahlin' are printed on the bottom of the image.
